facts.rule: For one selector segment with no explicit metrics segment, all tokens in ALLOWED_METRICS means metric selection; otherwise node selection. Only the two existing literal fixture paths below are attributed here.

attributions.reason: _local is not an allowed metric; node selector branch.
Both tokens are explicitly allowed metrics; metric branch.

limitations: This attributes existing raw observations only; no new runtime calls or semantic coverage.
Other selectors and ambiguous path APIs remain unresolved.
facts.reviewed_source_change: Exact8.11 primary bytes retained; node metric enum moved to NodesInfoMetrics, no inherited HTTP coverage.

limitations: Only independently indexed v2 observations; historical v1 remains separate.
An HTTP 2xx observation can be an application-level refusal or a failed expectation.
Only the most specific exact source route receives a request; ties stay unassigned.
Compatibility media are separated from default media; no support is inferred.
Query appearance, omitted values and linked recipe assertions do not establish semantics or defaults.
Body/header/error/async/state/platform obligations remain open; no overall coverage percentage.
